column1: # The icons the Rust renderer draws (crates/icons), as Compose held them: a name, the viewport's
# width and height, then each path's nodes, tab-separated. Names are Compose's (Filled.Search, from
# mirrored Backspace in lib/compose, Apache-2.0) or a vector drawable's in
# app/src/main/res/drawable (drawable.ic_incognito; Pictogrammers' Material Design Icons and
# FlorisBoard's, Apache-2.0). A path is its PathNodes as SVG commands, each number as Kotlin writes
# a Float. Generated: IconSourcesTest (app/src/test) writes app/build/icons/sources.tsv from the
# vectors and fails while this file differs; copy that file here.
